nom: PanOxyl Acne Treatment Bar with 10% Benzoyl Peroxide

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin who expected the 10% benzoyl peroxide bar to be too drying report being pleasantly surprised that it did not dry out their skin at all.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, with several reporting no dryness or irritation even with regular use, though one finds it harsh enough on her sensitive face that she now limits it to body use only.

concerns.blemishes: The great majority of reviewers, across face, back, chest, and body acne, report fewer and less severe breakouts within days to a few weeks of regular use, with several noting it also helps prevent new pimples from forming. A minority saw no real improvement even after two weeks to a month, and a couple of reviewers report existing breakouts getting worse before the product started working.
concerns.dehydration: Drying is the most frequently reported side effect, ranging from mild tightness to flaking, and is generally described as manageable by following up with a moisturizer or using the bar less often; several reviewers say it is too drying to use on the face even though it works well on the body. A substantial number of reviewers, including some with dry or sensitive skin, report the opposite: no dryness at all, even with daily use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report the bar reduces it as breakouts calm down, with none of the irritation, burning, or redness some feared from a 10% benzoyl peroxide formula. One reviewer is an exception: using it on her chest left her skin itchy and red with a few new breakouts, though she had no issue using it on her face.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the bar fading discoloration, dark spots, and uneven tone left by past breakouts, and one notes it helped prevent the scarring that can follow bad acne. No reviewer in this set reports it worsening spots or discoloration.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers describe the bar as helping control oiliness and leaving pores looking cleaner and less congested without over-drying the skin.

aspects.libelle: Rich lather from just a small amount
Little to no noticeable scent for most
Bleaches towels and fabric, needs white linens
Bar format lasts a long time, good value
Some wish it came as a liquid or pump
Stings noticeably on broken skin or cuts

extraits.titre: Aggressive formula: caused discomfort and failed to impro...
extraits.texte: Regarding Effectiveness and Results, this product did not work for my skin; I saw no improvement in my Acne during the time I used it. As for Foaming, it lathers well, but I noticed it has a strong bleaching effect, as it completely discolored my washing sponge. During the Duration of my use, l also experienced persistent headaches, which is concerning. Given that l am pregnant, this product proved too harsh for my needs, and I had to discontinue use.

extraits.titre: Works good for body, but not for face
extraits.texte: This was way too drying for me to use in my face. My skin immediately felt tight and got flakey after using it for a couple days on my face. However, I did use it on my body and it worked much better. I don't have a lot of body acne, so I mainly used it on my armpits to help kill bacteria and it kept my fresher for longer. I would not recommend using this on your face, but otherwise it's pretty good!

I really like this product for my face, but not as much for my body. I used it on my face and didn't notice any side effects, but I used it on my chest and was left itchy and red, with a few new breakouts. I will still continue to use for my face nightly!
This soap is really helping me with my body acne. It can be a bit harsh on my sensitive face but works great on body. Lathers up good and doesn't have any extra irritating ingredients.

extraits.titre: A little goes a LONG way
extraits.texte: This is a really good product. I already use the liquid form for my face however, I think this is so much better because I cannot stress enough how much a little goes a long way. All I have to do is swipe my hand once on it and I'm left with some white residue and when I filled it up in my hands, I have so much like enough for my entire back. I also use this on my back for my back acne and it did get more irritated at first because it always gets worse before it gets better but a couple weeks into it. It started visibly reducing. As someone with really sensitive skin I am not affected by this product. It doesn't dry my skin down or make me feel itchy and it's just really good. I did experience some peeling around my nose area, but it's not painful and all I do is put moisturizer on it and it gets better. And I was concerned about the fact this is a bar soap and how bacteria can grow however, it seems to maintain a very clean form and it's produced to avoid the build of bacteria which is good because it won't be adding bacteria to your face, and I'll actually help take it off. On my face, and I had some really active dark spots in and spots and acne. And it's been about two weeks and they are already looking better. It's less of a breakout now and more of just scarring. Overall, I love this product and anything from this brand and I would 100% recommend to anyone.

This has done wonders for my skin! I have been using it consistently at least once per day and my acne has greatly improved. I don't typically use a bar soap one because of hygiene and two because my skin is on the dry side and i assumed it would be drying but this was not at all. It left my skin feeling clean. I do remove my makeup with a different cleanser and go in with this for my double cleanse. If you are acne prone like me I would recommend trying this out. Also it did not bleach my clothes which some acne treatments tend to do.

I have used the PanOxyl Acne Bar for just about a month now and am extremely satisfied with the results. I suffer from adult acne but also have dry skin. This bar has helped to reduce the number of breakouts to just almost none and does not dry out my skin. This is a wonderful product
